meta.promotion_rule: Only outputs labeled promotable may be used as manuscript results. Scenario grids are comparative boundaries, not clinical predictions.

single_centre_pgt_m_a.source: Poulton et al. 2025, J Assist Reprod Genet

systematic_review_pgt_m.source: Poulton et al. 2025, Am J Obstet Gynecol

realistic_ivf.interpretation: Use empirical scenarios and sensitivity bounds rather than one universal IVF success constant.

selection_burden.interpretation: Non-selection counts failure of the target criterion only; it is not final embryo disposition.

selection_correction_crossover.formula: q=u+(1-u)c; crossover when q*r_e > u*r_s; equivalently r_e/r_s > u/q
selection_correction_crossover.interpretation: Threshold concerns reproductive yield only. It does not include editing safety, developmental loss, off-target effects, mosaicism or intergenerational risk.

eshre_2019_2021.group: combined PGT-M/PGT-SR with PGT-A; embryos non-genetically-transferable for the PGT-M/PGT-SR target
eshre_2019_2021.interpretation: Genotype-based non-selection is not equivalent to embryo destruction or discard; final disposition is a separate observed outcome.

gate2_tractability.reason: The current Gate-2 summary aggregates condition medians, while the canonical S1 headline is the median of the joint Monte Carlo distribution. ClinVar record counts also measure reported allelic diversity rather than patient-frequency weights. Per-draw tractability aggregation and population-weighted allele spectra are required for a headline population-share claim.

dollar_costs.reason: The germline-editing programme cost anchor is explicitly placeholder=true and several implementation unit costs remain reasoned rather than primary-source anchored.
dollar_costs.resource_analysis_status: Procedure, embryo and transfer quantities are promotable; dollar costs remain exploratory only.
